subject.title: fix(gateway): bound BOOT.md file read size

question: Should a BOOT.md larger than 16 MiB be silently skipped as empty, or return a visible failed boot result?
rationale: Both outcomes prevent unbounded allocation, but only a failed result tells operators that their configured startup instructions were not executed.

options.title: Fail visibly
options.body: Return a failed boot result so operators can identify and correct an oversized BOOT.md.

options.title: Skip as empty
options.body: Retain silent skipping only after explicit acceptance of the reduced operator visibility.

recommendation.title: Fail visibly
recommendation.body: Return a failed boot result so operators can identify and correct an oversized BOOT.md.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the BOOT.md startup behavior and its original missing/empty semantics.
